channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Anduril COO breaks down his method for catching up on Slack messages
item.description: Anduril COO Matt Grimm said that he sorts for the most recent, unread Slack messages and reads them in his downtime.

item.title: Hate your old Gmail address? Google is quietly letting some people change it without losing data
item.description: A Hindi version of Google's support page suggests that Google is testing a service to let users change their Gmail addresses without sacrificing data.

item.title: Forget Target. This year's last-minute holiday shoppers flocked to a lesser-known — but fast-growing — bargain outlet
item.description: Ollie's, which aims to provide customers with a "treasure-hunt" vibe, has been experiencing rapid growth, opening 86 locations in 2025.

item.title: These 13 creator economy startups pulled in about $2 billion in funding this year
item.description: From live shopping startup Whatnot to AI music platform Suno, meet the creator economy startups that raised massive deals in 2025.

item.title: The 'Marty Supreme' cast is full of familiar faces and memorable cameos
item.description: Did you spot all the famous faces in "Marty Supreme"? Here we break down the entire cast and cameos.

item.title: My 65-year-old mom is healthy, but she started purging her stuff. Being part of the process is helping me learn about my family.
item.description: My mom began Swedish death cleaning to prepare for the future — but what she really gave me was peace, connection, and understanding.

item.title: Airlines are canceling flights ahead of a winter storm. Here's what to do if your flight is delayed or canceled.
item.description: As a snow storm heads toward the New York City area, airlines are delaying and canceling thousands of flights.

item.title: I tried the famous $140 cake that Tom Cruise gifts to his celebrity friends every holiday season
item.description: Every holiday season, Tom Cruise sends a white chocolate coconut bundt cake to a group of famous friends. The cake is available on Goldbelly for $140.

item.title: 'Misery Map' shows holiday travel chaos on both coasts with canceled and delayed flights
item.description: According to the "Misery Map," which tracks real-time flight disruptions, there have been hundreds of delays and cancellations.

item.title: Burned out in her 50s, she left corporate life. Starting over in Korea helped her heal.
item.description: Jane Newman says it's been easy to meet new people in Seoul, including through a fan group for a Korean actor she likes.
